items.html: And this is the order of his expansion within them: for the head of Adam HaRishon was then in the world of Beria, which is now the place of ZA of Atzilut, as mentioned. And his throat was in the first four [Sefirot] of Yetzira, which is now the place of the Nukva of Atzilut. And you already know that the Nukva of Atzilut is called the Garden of Eden; hence it is found that only his throat was placed in the Garden of Eden.
